# Soap Club

The first rule of Soap Club: you tell everyone about Soap Club.

Fictional test brand. All artwork in this folder is original.

- Heading: Helvetica Neue; fallback Arial.
- Body: Georgia; fallback Arial.
- Primary: #302F35; accent: #D36F50; ink: #211F24.
- Muted: #8D8180; surface: #F4ECE5; background: #FFFFFF.
- Logos: transparent PNG, with SVG source in `assets/svg/`.
- Icons: six transparent 256 px alpha masks in `assets/icons/`.
- Hero: `assets/hero.png`, 2400 x 1350 RGB illustration of soap products.
- Icon names: box, delivery, document, growth, people, spark. Use the transparent alpha as a recolorable mask.
